sources.title: Kimi-K2-Instruct-0905 model card
sources.evidence: Exact revision card supplies nominal 1T total and 32B activated parameters, MoE with MLA, 256K context, text chat, tool calling, improved coding, and published model weights.

sources.title: Kimi-K2-Instruct-0905 configuration
sources.evidence: Raw config accessed: DeepseekV3ForCausalLM; model_type kimi_k2; max_position_embeddings 262144; 61 layers, first_k_dense_replace 1, 384 routed experts, 8 selected per token, one shared expert, 64 attention heads, and FP8 block quantization.

sources.title: Kimi-K2-Instruct-0905 Modified MIT License
sources.evidence: Raw license grants use, modification and distribution subject to MIT terms plus displaying Kimi K2 for commercial products exceeding 100 million monthly active users or US$20 million monthly revenue.

sources.title: Kimi K2 model update: stronger coding and faster API
sources.evidence: Dated September 5, 2025; explicitly announces release of version 0905 that day, its 128K-to-256K context extension, improved agentic/frontend coding, the kimi-k2-0905-preview API, and downloadable Hugging Face weights.

sources.title: Kimi-K2-Instruct-0905 tool-calling guide
sources.evidence: Raw guide accessed in the exact checkpoint repository: tools are function schemas; calls use tool_calls and tool-role replies. Native delimiters include tool_calls_section_begin, tool_call_begin and tool_call_argument_begin. IDs use functions.func_name:idx with a global invocation counter.

sources.title: Kimi-K2-Instruct-0905 causal transformer implementation
sources.evidence: Raw implementation accessed: DeepseekV3Model is explicitly a transformer decoder; each decoder layer has attention and an MLP or routed MoE; DeepseekV3ForCausalLM adds a vocabulary projection. Its documented native interface consumes token IDs and produces text-token logits.

sources.title: Kimi K2: Open Agentic Intelligence, July 2025 report
sources.evidence: July 28 report describes the original K2 as non-thinking and gives 1.04T total / 32.6B active in architecture Table 2. It does not identify September 0905, so these more precise counts and non-thinking classification are not transferred to this revision.

sources.title: Kimi K2 Thinking model card and K2 0905 comparisons
sources.evidence: Later card has separate K2 Thinking and K2 0905 evaluation columns. Its architecture summary and native INT4/extended-thinking descriptions concern Thinking, not the 0905 baseline; the 0905 comparison column does not disclose new parameter counts or explicitly classify its reasoning mode.

sources.title: Kimi K2.5 model card
sources.evidence: Later multimodal K2.5 card was checked for exact 0905 evidence; it supplies no 0905-labeled parameter comparison. K2.5 image/video capabilities are not evidence for 0905.

sources.title: Kimi Research Blog release index
sources.evidence: Separately dates Kimi-K2-Instruct-0905 to 2025-09-05, original Kimi K2 to 2025-07-11, K2 Thinking to 2025-11-06 and K2.5 to 2026-01-27.

name.note: Display spelling of the exact Kimi-K2-Instruct-0905 checkpoint.

developer.note: Official publisher and license copyright owner.

release_date.note: Explicit dated announcement and exact-model research-index entry. Earlier repository staging commits do not establish earlier public availability.

open_weights.note: Official weights released for download and reuse under the stated license.

license.note: MIT-derived license with a Kimi K2 display requirement above the stated commercial usage/revenue thresholds; not plain MIT.

parameters_b.note: Nominal 1T = 1000B from the exact 0905 card; not an exact tensor count.

active_parameters_b.note: Explicit nominal activated count; not inferred from routing or copied from another revision.

architecture.note: Decoder-only MoE transformer with MLA; 61 layers including one dense layer, 384 routed experts, 8 selected per token, one shared expert and 64 attention heads.

context_window.note: Native checkpoint max_position_embeddings is 262144, matching the announced 256K extension; not an output-token limit.

modalities.note: Text chat and causal text-token model; the exact native implementation has token embeddings and a vocabulary output head.

reasoning.note: Dedicated thinking-mode classification remains unverified. The exact 0905 card does not explicitly state non-thinking; July claims and the distinct later Thinking model do not establish this boolean. No inference from absent controls or metadata.

tool_call.note: Explicit exact-model tool calling with native parser requirements, function schemas, structured calls, tool-role results and functions.func_name:idx identifiers.

description.value: September 2025 Kimi K2 instruction update with a 256K context and improved agentic coding
description.note: Dated release directly supports the existing description; coding improvement is the developer-reported update.

patch.notes: Parameter counts are the exact 0905 card's nominal 1T total and 32B activated. July K2 report counts of 1.04T/32.6B are not transferred. The native checkpoint is a decoder-only MoE transformer with MLA and 262,144-token context; FP8 scale/storage elements are not counted as learned parameters. Dedicated reasoning-mode classification remains unverified.
